description: Two FLiDAR buoys will be deployed.
context_quote: Equinor Wind US LLC has prepared this Site Assessment Plan (SAP) in support of the installation and operation of two floating light detection and ranging buoys (FLiDARs)

description: One metocean buoy will be deployed.
context_quote: Equinor Wind US LLC has prepared this Site Assessment Plan (SAP) in support of the installation and operation of ... one metocean buoy

description: One subsurface current meter mooring will be deployed.
context_quote: Equinor Wind US LLC has prepared this Site Assessment Plan (SAP) in support of the installation and operation of ... one subsurface current meter mooring

description: FLiDAR buoys will be decommissioned after two years of operation.
context_quote: The two RPS FLiDAR Buoys are scheduled to be decommissioned at the end of their two-year operational life

description: The Wave and Met Buoy will be decommissioned after four years.
context_quote: the Met and Wave Buoy ... will be decommissioned at the end of four years.

description: The CM/CT mooring will be decommissioned after four years.
context_quote: the ... CM/CT mooring will be decommissioned at the end of four years.

description: The FLiDAR buoy hull is 15.2 feet in diameter.
context_quote: The 5005-grade H34 aluminum superstructure is powder coated and measures 15.2 feet (ft) (4.63 meters [m]) in diameter.

description: The FLiDAR buoy weighs 9,480 pounds.
context_quote: The weight of the entire buoy including all electronics and keel is 9,480 pounds (lbs) (4,300kilograms [kg]) (4.3 metric tons).

description: The Wave and Met Buoy is 8.5 feet in diameter.
context_quote: The RPS Wave and Met Buoy is a 8.5 ft (2.6 m) round buoy

description: The Wave and Met Buoy weighs 4,409 lbs.
context_quote: The Wave and Met Buoy weighs 4,409 lbs (2,000 kg).

description: Landing areas have been minimized and anti-perching devices will be installed on the lights and mast.
context_quote: Landing areas have been minimized and anti-perching devices will be installed on the lights and mast.

description: Horizontal surfaces have been minimized to limit potential ice/snow build up.
context_quote: horizontal surfaces have been minimized to limit the potential ice/snow build up.

description: FLiDAR buoys will transmit data every 10 minutes.
context_quote: 10-minute average wind speed and direction profiles, as well as system voltage information and charge discharge rates will be transmitted every 10 minutes

description: The Wave and Met Buoy will transmit data every 30 minutes.
context_quote: Wave and met parameters, including 30 minute wave spectrum and 3 x 10 minute met parameter data, will be transmitted ... every 30 minutes.

description: Vessels must maintain a 1NM buffer from Traffic Separation Schemes.
context_quote: taking into consideration the required buffer of 1NM from Traffic Separation Schemes (TSS).

description: Planned maintenance for the FLiDAR buoys is scheduled at 6-month intervals.
context_quote: Planned on-site maintenance for the RPS FLiDAR Buoys is scheduled at 6-month intervals

description: Planned maintenance for the Wave and Met Buoy is scheduled every 6 months.
context_quote: Planned on-site maintenance for the Wave and Met Buoy is scheduled every 6 months

description: Planned maintenance for the CM/CT Mooring is scheduled every 6 months.
context_quote: Planned on-site maintenance for the CM/CT Mooring is scheduled every 6 months

description: Vessels conducting activities must comply with vessel-strike avoidance measures.
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure that all vessels conducting activities in support of the plan submittal, including those transiting to and from local ports and the lease area, comply with the vessel-strike avoidance measures specified in stipulations 4.2

description: Vessels 65 ft or greater operating from November 1 through April 30 must operate at speeds of 10 knots or less.
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure that vessels 65 ft (19.8 m) in length or greater, operating from November 1 through April 30, operate at speeds of 10 knots (<18.5 km/hr) or less.

description: All vessels must maintain a separation distance of 1,640 ft or greater from any sighted North Atlantic right whale.
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure all survey vessels maintain a separation distance of 1,640 ft (500 m) or greater from any sighted North Atlantic right whale.

description: All vessels must maintain a separation distance of 328 ft or greater from any sighted non-delphinoid cetacean.
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure all vessels maintain a separation distance of 328 ft (100 m) or greater from any sighted non-delphinoid cetacean.

description: All vessels must maintain a separation distance of 164 ft or greater from any sighted sea turtle.
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure all vessels maintain a separation distance of 164 ft (50 m) or greater from any sighted sea turtle.
